asked.item: Where did Overview go (menu only shows Post editor)

verdict.reason: The pages say Overview is in Developer Platform mode and Post editor is in Content Studio, and how to switch modes.

steps.text: Blotato has 2 navigation modes in the same account.
Developer Platform includes Overview for monitoring, while Content Studio includes Post editor.
To see Overview, use the mode switch beneath the Blotato name and switch to Developer Platform.
